name: command-centre
description: A right-hand pane listing your agents (last run, failures) and the open to-dos from your notes file, refreshed every five minutes.

agentsDir.title: Agents folder
agentsDir.description: Absolute path to a folder holding one sub-folder (or log file) per agent. Each agent's newest file time is its last run; its newest log is scanned for failures.

notesFile.title: Notes file
notesFile.description: Absolute path to your notes file (second brain). Unchecked '- [ ]' lines are listed as open to-dos.
